name: Tarahiplus Bulk Price Editor for WooCommerce
author: arman siahloo

sections.description:
Tarahiplus Bulk Price Editor (قیمت پلاس) changes the prices of many WooCommerce products at once — safely. Increase or decrease prices by a percentage or a fixed amount, preview every before/after price, apply the change in small batches, and roll back any operation later with one click.

The admin panel is fully in Persian (RTL), with Jalali (Shamsi) dates in the history and support for Persian/Arabic digits in every input.

Features

  • Increase or decrease by percentage or fixed amount
  • Apply to the regular price, the sale price, or both
  • Works with simple, variable (every variation) and external products
  • Filters: product type, publish status, categories (include / exclude), brand and any other product taxonomy (tags, attributes, custom taxonomies — detected automatically, whoever registered them), product IDs (include / exclude), price range, only products on sale
  • Smart rounding: none, decimals, or multiples of 10 up to 100,000 — round to nearest, up or down
  • Live preview with before/after prices, warnings, and CSV export
  • Batch processing with progress bar — safe for large stores and slow hosts
  • History and rollback: every operation is stored and can be restored individually
  • Never applies a zero or negative price
  • Persian (RTL) interface, Jalali dates, Persian digits accepted

Requirements

WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Developer

Designed and developed by Tarahi Plus (طراحی پلاس) — Arman Siahloo (آرمان سیاهلو). https://tarahiplus.ir/

توضیحات فارسی

«قیمت پلاس» ابزار سریع و ایمن برای تغییر گروهی قیمت محصولات ووکامرس است:

  • افزایش یا کاهش درصدی و مبلغ ثابت
  • اعمال روی قیمت عادی، قیمت ویژه یا هر دو
  • پشتیبانی از محصول ساده، متغیر (تک‌تک ورییشن‌ها) و خارجی
  • فیلتر بر اساس دسته‌بندی، برند و هر تاکسونومی دیگر (شناسایی خودکار)، شناسه، بازه‌ی قیمت و وضعیت انتشار
  • گرد کردن هوشمند قیمت نهایی (مضرب ۱۰ تا ۱۰۰٬۰۰۰)
  • پیش‌نمایش کامل قبل از اعمال و خروجی CSV
  • پردازش مرحله‌ای با نوار پیشرفت برای فروشگاه‌های بزرگ
  • تاریخچه‌ی عملیات با تاریخ شمسی و بازگردانی هر عملیات با یک کلیک

Credits

The admin panel uses the Vazirmatn font (SIL Open Font License 1.1) by Saber Rastikerdar.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Activate Tarahiplus Bulk Price Editor from the Plugins screen.
  4. Open the قیمت پلاس menu in the WordPress admin.
sections.faq:
Can I undo a price change?

Yes. Every applied operation is stored in the History tab and can be rolled back individually. Rolling back restores the prices to the values before that operation.

Can I change prices for only one brand?

Yes. The plugin detects all product taxonomies automatically (brand taxonomies from any plugin or theme, tags, attributes, custom taxonomies). Open the taxonomy in the filter section and select the terms to include or exclude.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Prices are changed on each variation, then the parent product’s price range is synchronized.

Will it time out on a large store?

Operations run in small batches via AJAX with a progress bar. You can lower the batch size in the Settings tab on slow hosts.

Does it send data to external servers?

No. The plugin does not connect to any external service.
